definitions.gloss: everywhere; all over the place; wherever you go
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something exists or occurs in every location or in many different places.

examples.japanese: {至|いた}る{所|ところ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。

examples.english: When spring comes, cherry blossoms bloom everywhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{至|いた}る{所|ところ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Vending machines are installed everywhere in this city.

notes:
{至|いた}る{所|ところ} means "everywhere" or "all over." Literally "the place one arrives at" — i.e., wherever you go.

USAGE:
Functions as a noun, typically followed by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧. Can also be written ⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧ (hiragana for ⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧). Slightly more literary than ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be everywhere
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧: to see in many places
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread everywhere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: everywhere (casual)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧: here and there (scattered)
- {至|いた}る{所|ところ}: everywhere (slightly formal, emphatic)
